name: Michael Verdon
headline: I build software that sits where engineering meets creativity.
intro: I'm an Associate Software Engineer at JP Morgan, where I work in Payments Technology and on AI solutions. Before that I worked at Invertase on open-source tools that developers around the world rely on. I'm drawn to artificial intelligence and creative technology, and I love turning an idea into something people can actually use.

timeline.label: Studied
timeline.title: MEng Computer Science, Distinction
timeline.text: Where I went deep on machine learning, fuzzy systems and robotics, and found out how much I enjoy building things that think.

timeline.label: Trained
timeline.title: Software Engineering Bootcamp
timeline.text: An intense, hands-on course in test-driven development, pairing and shipping in teams.

timeline.label: Before
timeline.title: Junior Software Engineer
timeline.place: Invertase · Cross Platform Engineer / Open Source
timeline.text: Working on React Native Firebase and FlutterFire, the open-source libraries that connect thousands of apps to Firebase.

timeline.label: Now
timeline.title: Associate Software Engineer
timeline.text: Building payments systems and AI solutions at global scale, using Java, Spring Boot, Maven, MongoDB, Liquibase and Kubernetes on the back end and React, Redux Toolkit and TypeScript on the front end.
